UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: User profile with study stats, tickets, and customization settings

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user

avatarConfigJson.description: Serialized JSON string of the user avatar configuration

deskConfigJson.description: Serialized JSON string of desk workstation accessories

unlockedItemsJson.description: Serialized JSON string of unlocked shop items

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp when the user profile was created

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp when the user profile was last updated

BookshelfItem.title: Bookshelf Item
BookshelfItem.description: Books saved, marked as reading or completed, along with reader notes and bookmarks

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the owner

category.description: Genre or category of the book

notes.description: Personal reader notes, favorite quotes, or study thoughts

claimedBonus.description: Whether completion bonus tickets were claimed

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this bookshelf entry was updated

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this bookshelf entry was created

CafeSharedNote.title: Cafe Shared Note
CafeSharedNote.description: Public sticky notes and book recommendations on the cafe community board

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the author

category.description: Category tag for the recommendation or thought

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this note was posted

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile, tickets, focus stats, and customization

/users/{userId}/books/{bookId}.description: Stores personal bookshelf items, reading status, bookmarks, and notes

/cafe_notes/{noteId}.description: Stores public sticky notes and book recommendations left by coworkers
